name: @pipeworx/mcp-prozorro-sale

tools.name: prozorro_sale_search
tools.description: Search Prozorro.Sale, Ukraine's public auction system for STATE and MUNICIPAL asset sales and leases (not procurement — for tenders use prozorro_search_tenders). Covers land-lease and land-sale auctions, municipal/state property leases, small privatisation, bankruptcy estates, timber, railway cargo, subsoil. Filter by direction (auction family), status, region (oblast), locality, free text, start-price range and modified date. Returns procedures newest-modified first with status, start price, region, seller, bid count and the upstream protected-record flags. Text is Ukrainian as published.

direction.description: Auction family (metaInfo.directions). Known values: landRental (land-lease rights), landSell, landArrested (seized land), legitimatePropertyLease and commercialPropertyLease (state/municipal property leases), regulationsPropertyLease, sellOut (small privatisation), largePrivatization, bankRuptcy, commercialSell, otherAssets, alienation, timber, subsoil, railwayCargo.

status.description: Procedure status, e.g. active_tendering (open for bids), active_rectification, active_auction, active_qualification, active_awarded, pending_payment, complete, unsuccessful, cancelled.

selling_method.description: Exact sellingMethod, e.g. landRental-english, smallPrivatization-dutch, legitimatePropertyLease-priorityEnglish.

category.description: metaInfo category, e.g. agriLandLease, otherLandLease, agriLandSale, realEstateLease, commercialSale, cars.

region.description: Oblast as published in Ukrainian, e.g. "Київська область", "Львівська область". English oblast names (e.g. "Kyiv", "Lviv") are translated.

query.description: Full-text search over titles and descriptions (Ukrainian works best), e.g. "Бровари" or a cadastral number.

modified_since.description: Only procedures modified on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime).

tools.name: prozorro_sale_procedure
tools.description: Full detail of one Prozorro.Sale auction by its public auction id (e.g. "LRE001-UA-20260813-89379") or internal 24-hex id: items (cadastral numbers, areas, addresses), start price, guarantee, bids with amounts and bidder organisations, awards, signed contracts, cancellations, related registry assets, and the REPEAT-AUCTION CHAIN (earlier failed attempts and later repeats of the same lot). Protected-record flags are passed through verbatim.

id.description: Public auction id (e.g. LRE001-UA-20260813-89379) or the 24-hex internal id.

tools.name: prozorro_sale_asset
tools.description: Look up a Prozorro.Sale registry object — usually a privatisation ASSET (id like "RAS001-UA-20260512-28803") or its 24-hex registry id — with its title, status, holder, items and the auctions it was offered in. Find asset ids in prozorro_sale_procedure related_entities.

tools.name: prozorro_sale_changes
tools.description: Incremental feed of Prozorro.Sale procedures modified on/after a timestamp, oldest first — the upstream change feed. Returns summaries plus next_since to continue from. Use to track new auctions, status changes and results since a point in time.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-prozorro-sale forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the prozorro-sale pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
